Legenda original:
One week only! Watch pavingthewaymovie, a short documentary by filmmaker keelantw and scored by OfficialAment, now streaming at the 🔗 in bio.

Set across the vast landscapes of the Flathead Indian Reservation, the film follows the creative spirit and resilience of a skateboarder, seamstress, and artist as five new skateparks rise across the reservation, built through montanapoolservice, the non-profit organization founded by Jeff.
